depth.note: a methylation state is only identified where a CpG is observed repeatedly; below ~2 observations per CpG the per-CpG state carries no information

matched_locus_boundary_estimator.note: too few CpGs covered by both arms

interpretation.coverage_baseline: coverage_baseline_n_cpgs_auc is the number of covered CpGs alone; a methylation feature must beat it to mean anything
interpretation.boundary_estimator: mean_unmethylated_fraction is the share of a CpG's observations that sit at a fragment end; it estimates the unmethylated state without a model, a prior or training
interpretation.matched_locus: the matched-locus tests restrict both arms to the CpGs they share, so a difference there cannot be produced by library composition
interpretation.decoder_degeneracy: fraction_intermediate near zero means the decoder returned hard 0/1 calls, so the beta summary is a count of called states rather than a graded methylation level
